<thought>To locate a retrosynthetic template that corresponds to an SN2 substitution (breaking a halide C–Cl bond and forming a C–N bond), I will search the template catalog using bond criteria: bonds_broken = ["C-Cl"] and bonds_formed = ["C-N"]. This should return templates that match the forward reaction of halide displacement by a nitrogen nucleophile.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "COc1cccc(NC(=O)c2nnn(Cc3ccc(CN4CC(F)C4)cc3)c2N)c1",
    "bonds_broken": ["C-Cl"],
    "bonds_formed": ["C-N"],
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
